276471503.description:
Artist Unknown
Hand-Carved Folk Art Mask Collection
Hand-Carved Wood with Pigment and Fiber
Multiple Dimensions (Large mask approx. 20" H)
Unsigned (One bears Indonesian export label)
This eclectic collection features three distinct hand-carved wooden wall masks, each showcasing different folk art traditions and motifs. The largest piece is a dark-stained Indonesian mask featuring a raised lizard or salamander on the forehead. The second mask depicts a characterful male face with a mustache, beard, and smoking pipe, while the third is a stylized horned animal mask with bold yellow and black geometric patterns and natural burlap fringe.
Hand-carved from solid wood with varying stains and painted accents
Largest mask features "Made in Indonesia" label on reverse with handwritten "RIDHO. 1"
Integrated hanging cords or loops on the reverse of each piece
Largest mask measures approximately 20 inches in height
Condition:
Good vintage condition with visible character and wear. The large mask shows some scuffing and finish loss on the lips and lizard leg as seen in close-up photos. The bull mask has fraying to the jute fringe consistent with age and material. No structural cracks or significant damage noted to the wood supports.
